term: Maharashtra Advanced Research and Vigilance for Enhanced Law Enforcement
definition: Maharashtra Advanced Research and Vigilance for Enhanced Law Enforcement (MARVEL) is an artificial intelligence (AI) system implemented by the Maharashtra Police.
details: It is noted for being the first state-level police AI system in India. Approved in 2024, MARVEL aims to integrate AI technologies into law enforcement to enhance crime-solving capabilities and improve predictive policing.

explainer.lead: MARVEL is an artificial intelligence system implemented by the Maharashtra Police and noted as the first state-level police AI system in India. Approved in 2024, it integrates AI into law enforcement to enhance crime-solving and predictive policing.

tiers.eli5: It's a police computer helper that tries to solve crimes faster and predict where trouble may happen.
tiers.practitioner: Law enforcement uses it for crime-solving and predictive policing; the obvious pitfall in predictive policing is acting on predictions as if they were evidence.
